answer.short: Rectangular prism: width $4\,\mathrm{m}$, height $3\,\mathrm{m}$ and depth $5\,\mathrm{m}$.
answer.worked: Draw the rectangular end and extend equal, parallel depth edges. Join the back vertices and dash the hidden edges. Label the height $3\,\mathrm{m}$, front width $4\,\mathrm{m}$ and depth $5\,\mathrm{m}$.

spec.description: Editable rectangular prism with all three given dimensions transferred to the appropriate edge directions.

answer.short: Hexagonal prism of depth $5\,\mathrm{m}$; each end-face edge is $2\,\mathrm{m}$.
answer.worked: Draw the hexagonal end and extend equal, parallel depth edges to a congruent back end. Join corresponding vertices and dash the hidden edges. Label the depth $5\,\mathrm{m}$. The top view gives the horizontal end edge as $2\,\mathrm{m}$; the matching ticks give the same length for all six end edges.

spec.description: Editable hexagonal prism with six matching end-edge ticks, a 2 m horizontal end edge and 5 m depth.

mathematics.extrusion: Front vertices have z=0; corresponding primed vertices have z=5.
mathematics.constraints: All six front edges have length 2 m. This is one compatible regular-looking sketch; equal angles are not asserted as a source given and no additional dimensions are inferred.

spec.description: Front/Back: quadrilateral with a tall left wall, short right wall and descending straight upper edge; labels 6 m, 2 m and 5 m remain on their respective edges.
spec.mathematics: Height difference is 4 m. The separate top view supplies width 3 m, consistent with slope length 5 m since 3²+4²=5². This check is not added to the student prompt.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied given; the 3 m width is not added to this question view.

answer.short: Prism as shown: width $3\,\mathrm{m}$, depth $7\,\mathrm{m}$, vertical end edges $6\,\mathrm{m}$ and $2\,\mathrm{m}$, and sloping end edge $5\,\mathrm{m}$.
answer.worked: Draw the quadrilateral end, with vertical edges $6\,\mathrm{m}$ and $2\,\mathrm{m}$, base $3\,\mathrm{m}$ and sloping edge $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Extend equal, parallel depth edges and join the back vertices. Label the depth $7\,\mathrm{m}$ and dash the hidden edges.

spec.description: Editable prism with a descending sloped upper face, all five distinct dimensions and two matching 7 m depth labels.

mathematics.consistency: The true cross-section has width 3 m and height difference 6−2=4 m, so its sloping upper edge has length sqrt(3²+4²)=5 m. Perspective coordinates are not used as true spatial lengths.
